title: Microsoft 365 Backup: Teams channel backup and recovery
summary: Pass: the roadmap scope and timing, existing-workload controls, and consumption billing are supported. Teams-specific defaults, roles and configuration are appropriately left unconfirmed. A minor qualification would acknowledge conflicting Microsoft instructions for existing customers' billing setup.
